newsitem.title: USA: DeepTech to buy back up to one mln shares.
newsitem.headline: DeepTech to buy back up to one mln shares.

text.p: DeepTech International Inc said Monday it board had authorized the repurchase of up to one million shares through September 30.
"Our board of directors believes that our shares are currently undervalued, given the present and expected performance of our operating subsidiaries," said Chief Executive Thomas Tatham.
He cited a lack of institutional interest and the small size of the company's share base as reasons for the undervaluation.
DeepTech shares were unchanged at 6-1/8 at 1040 EST.
The offshore drilling contractor has about 18.6 million shares outstanding, and 9.6 million more are issuable upon the exercise of outstanding options.
